name: package.json: only dependency facts; scripts, repository, name and file/git/workspace deps stay home
package-lock.json v3: top-level registry packages with exact versions
requirements.txt: options, index URLs with credentials, editable/local/URL refs, hashes and markers dropped

files.requirements.txt:
# private index with credentials
--index-url https://user:pa55@pypi.acme.internal/simple
-e ./local-pkg
mcp==1.9.0 --hash=sha256:abcdef
Anthropic[bedrock] >= 0.60, <1 ; python_version >= "3.9"
private-thing @ git+https://token@github.com/acme/private-thing.git
requests
./wheels/acme-1.0.whl

name: pyproject.toml: PEP 621 + optional + poetry deps; path deps, project name and URLs dropped

files.pyproject.toml:
[project]
name = "acme-secret-service"
version = "1.0.0"
dependencies = [
  "openai>=1.40",  # comment
  "langchain-core==0.3.10",
]
[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = ["pytest>=8"]
[project.urls]
Repository = "https://github.internal/acme/secret"
[tool.poetry.dependencies]
python = "^3.11"
google-genai = "^1.2.0"
acme-internal = { path = "../acme-internal" }
httpx = { version = "~0.27", extras = ["http2"] }

name: poetry.lock and uv.lock: exact pypi versions; git and editable sources dropped

files.poetry.lock:
[[package]]
name = "mcp"
version = "1.9.0"

[[package]]
name = "acme-private"
version = "0.1.0"

[package.source]
type = "git"
url = "https://github.internal/acme/private.git"

[[package]]
name = "Pydantic_Core"
version = "2.23.4"
files.sub/uv.lock:
[[package]]
name = "acme-secret-service"
version = "1.0.0"
source = { editable = "." }

[[package]]
name = "anthropic"
version = "0.60.0"
source = { registry = "https://pypi.org/simple" }

name: yarn.lock: registry packages; file: entries dropped

files.yarn.lock:
# yarn lockfile v1

"@anthropic-ai/sdk@^0.60.0":
  version "0.60.0"
  resolved "https://registry.yarnpkg.com/@anthropic-ai/sdk/-/sdk-0.60.0.tgz"

zod@^3.23.0, zod@^3.24.0:
  version "3.24.1"

"internal@file:../internal":
  version "1.0.0"

name: workflow YAML: only third-party action refs; secrets, run steps, local and docker actions dropped

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: ci
env:
  TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with: { node-version: 20 }
      - uses: ./.github/actions/internal
      - uses: docker://alpine:3.19
      - run: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://deploy.internal
      - uses: "cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3.4.1"

workflows:
uses: actions/checkout@v4
uses: actions/setup-node@v3
